cultureFitReport.summary: This report outlines a strategic cultural adaptation plan for localizing an open-world crime drama game originally set in Chicago's underground courier syndicate scene. The adaptation preserves globally resonant narrative pillars while replacing generic or culturally mismatched elements with hyper-local Delhi references verified through Qloo Taste AI. Key changes include swapping greasy-spoon diners for upscale Delhi dining venues, replacing muscle cars with premium car culture hubs, and integrating Delhi-specific social rituals like chaat breaks and Bollywood lyric singalongs. These adjustments maintain the game's core gameplay loop while embedding players in an instantly recognizable Delhi underworld atmosphere.

keep_elements.name: Underground Network Mechanics
keep_elements.rationale: The core gameplay loop of managing a covert delivery network with risk/reward dynamics translates universally across cultures

keep_elements.name: Moral Ambiguity Narrative
keep_elements.rationale: Players globally engage with complex character motivations and ethical dilemmas in crime worlds

keep_elements.name: Dynamic World Reactions
keep_elements.rationale: Real-time environmental responses to player actions (e.g., police chases, rival gang conflicts) create immersive gameplay that works in any urban setting

swap_elements.replacement_element: Croma - Ambience Mall and Champa Gali as syndicate hubs
swap_elements.rationale: Replaces generic American diner aesthetic with Delhi's luxury retail and historic alleyway locations that reflect local power centers
Swaps American car culture for Delhi's affinity for luxury European automobiles, maintaining the vehicle's mechanical gameplay role

swap_elements.replacement_element: Le Méridien and JW Marriott hotel lounges
swap_elements.rationale: Replaces casual sports bars with Delhi's high-end hotel venues where business and underground dealings naturally intersect

add_elements.name: Chaat Break Rituals
add_elements.rationale: Integrating Delhi's iconic street food breaks creates authentic pauses in action and showcases local flavor without disrupting gameplay flow
add_elements.regional_habit: Characters take spontaneous 'chaat breaks' at street-side stalls between missions, restoring stamina with regional snacks like pani puri and kulfi

add_elements.name: Bollywood Lyric Singalongs
add_elements.rationale: Adding spontaneous musical moments with popular Bollywood/Punjabi tracks leverages Delhi's inherent musicality and creates memorable gameplay moments
add_elements.regional_habit: During low-stakes interactions, characters spontaneously sing along to hits by artists like Krsna and Seedhe Maut

add_elements.name: Traffic Chaos Navigation
add_elements.rationale: Embedding Delhi's legendary traffic chaos as a core gameplay element immediately establishes setting and adds strategic depth to courier missions
add_elements.regional_habit: Players must dynamically reroute through monsoon floods, rickshaw lanes, and construction zones mirroring real Delhi commuting challenges
